notes: Live defect (2026-08-04, on 4.95.0 the day it shipped): the new Processes tab hung at "Loading processes…" precisely while batches ran — the one moment it exists for. GET /cm/processes never answered during a running batch while the MCP get_processes tool (a different process) answered fine, which named the fault: event-loop starvation in the daemon. The batch ticks and the repricing scan run on the same event loop that serves /cm/*, and their long synchronous stretches never let a pending connection be accepted. Reproduced live before the fix: with the three batches started, every probe of /c
